rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a fixed 13-person rite and collective bonuses; a world can vary group size or leadership rules, balancing greater potency against coordination and participant requirements.

rules.statement: A corrupted Ability or Art grants +3 on selfish or sinful uses and penalizes neutral or selfless uses by −3. If that bonus turns failure into success, the user immediately gains 5 experience points in the Ability or Art; if the penalty causes failure, the user loses 5 points.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Flaws — Corrupted Abilities; Corrupted Arts (ars-magica-realms#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a sin-aligned +3/−3 modifier and experience gained or lost in 5-point steps; a world can change the modifiers or learning swing, making corruption more tempting or more punishing.

rules.statement: A hex must be given a physical expression and a declared intended outcome, using direct address, marked signs on or near the target, or a representation connected to the target by an Arcane Connection. Its severity is chosen by Ease Factor from 6+ for minor harm through 30+ for sudden death; delay modifies the Hex total from −12 for an immediate effect to +12 for one delayed a lifetime, with intermediate steps for hour, day, week, month, season, year, and generation.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Abilities — Hex Effects (ars-magica-realms#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to escalating severity thresholds and a delay bonus that strengthens later curses; a world can change the thresholds, delay scale, or targeting ritual, with time traded against immediate potency.

rules.statement: Corruption can force a Personality Trait onto listeners by spending 1 Confidence Point, affect readers who study the author’s writing for a season, or teach corrupted Abilities or Arts. A target who suspects or resists may roll Perception + Infernal Lore against the corrupter’s recorded roll total; success avoids the imposed trait or flaw while retaining experience, while failure wastes the season.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Abilities — Corruption (ars-magica-realms#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to influence that can be resisted by lore and suspicion, with Confidence spent for direct audience influence; a world can alter the resistance or duration, balancing subtle indoctrination against the risk of exposure.

rules.statement: Using Debauchery requires a strenuous physical act and costs either a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound; the roll uses Stamina. The act is the means of focusing the character’s will for the maleficium.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Abilities — Debauchery (ars-magica-realms#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a bodily cost for each use; a world can change whether fatigue or injury is paid, or how much, tying stronger effects to physical sacrifice.

rules.statement: A non-Infernal Power used for a non-sinful purpose can trigger an unpleasant, harmful side effect at about the same time. The consequence can vary with the use and may be blocked by Magic Resistance or protections that keep demons away, though the retaliating force can still sense the good use.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: New Flaws — Vengeful Powers (ars-magica-realms#058)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to harmful retaliation when a power is used for good, with protective wards blocking its arrival but not its detection; a world can tune the severity or trigger, making virtuous use carry a greater or lesser cost.

rules.statement: A religious absolution ceremony permanently removes every hex affecting the recipient. Other supernatural effects can also remove hexes; treat a hex as a spell with level equal to 10 times the number of botch dice it represents (for example, level 20 for a serious hex and level 40 for a critical one).
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Hex (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to letting supernatural cleansing undo hexes; a world can restrict which sources work, because the passage makes Divine absolution a common remedy but also allows other supernatural cures.

rules.statement: To invoke an Infernal effect with Incantation, the character must chant loudly or write out the maleficium’s terms, adds Communication to the roll, and spends 1 Confidence point.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Incantation (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring a spoken or written invocation and 1 Confidence; a world can vary the required form, with public speech or written terms exposing the user.

rules.statement: A character’s Hierarchy Score equals the level of their highest Reputation. It represents authority over demons and Infernal powers, while also reflecting the Infernal’s ill will toward the character.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Hierarchy (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to using the highest Reputation as the rank measure; a world can make rank more or less influential, since greater standing brings authority as well as danger.

rules.statement: When an infernalist gains at least 2 Warping Points at once, or fails to control Infernal power, they test Stamina + Concentration + Confidence Score + a stress die against Warping Score + Warping Points gained + Hierarchy Score + local aura + a stress die that cannot botch. Success ends the attack after two minutes; failure causes an ordeal whose duration uses the Wizard’s Twilight table, and afterward the character makes an Aging roll adding modified Warping Score. Avoiding the ordeal can raise Confidence Score by 1 if it is below Warping Score or Decrepitude, and grants Confidence Points equal to the Warping Points gained unless the avoidance roll botched.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Vituperation (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to testing control at the stated triggers and inflicting an aging-cost ordeal on failure; a world can make acceptance voluntary, since enduring it can strengthen Confidence.

rules.statement: A ritual sacrifice adds to the Infernal effect total: a target effigy gives +2, an animal +4, a black animal +6, a human +8, and an innocent human +10. The ritual usually takes about an extra hour.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Sacrifice (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting the listed bonus for each offering and adding roughly an hour; a world can forbid or change sacrifice, with the potency paid for in time and a victim’s life.

rules.statement: Profaning a clearly Divine-associated object costs 1 Confidence point and generally transforms it into 1 pawn of vis of a Form suited to the object. For a holy relic, the character spends no Confidence, but must have a Confidence Score greater than the relic’s Faith Score; otherwise the relic resists.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Profaning the Holy (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to producing one pawn from one object at the stated cost; a world can vary the vis outcome, while relics resist unless the profaner’s Confidence exceeds their Faith.

rules.statement: Demon-blooded humans cannot reproduce, though they feel the urge; they do not need food or drink, but still feel hunger and thirst. They have free will and are not automatically destined for Hell.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Characters with Demonic Blood (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to applying these bodily limits without dictating moral choice; a world can change the limits, while the ongoing urges can tempt the character toward sin.

rules.statement: A Devil Child’s Power frees a demon trapped in an object, place, or person that the child touches, but only after sunset and only until dawn. If the demon secures permanent release during that interval by destroying its prison or captor, it becomes bound to Abrigor’s service.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Malachi, Devil Child — Powers: Free the Devil’s Servant (ars-magica-realms#059)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a touch-based release lasting from sunset to dawn; a world can vary the release window or binding outcome, with permanent escape serving Abrigor.

rules.statement: A maleficium combines one Method and one Power. Its total is a stress die plus the Method’s associated Characteristic, Method score, Power score, and aura bonus; the caster chooses Range, Duration, and Target, defaulting to Personal, Momentary, and Individual, and succeeds if the total meets the effect’s target level.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 10: The Maleficia (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to learned Method-and-Power casting with Hermetic-style parameters; a world can change the pairings or parameters, because infernalists draw effects from Hell.

rules.statement: For a failed casting, count one botch for every 10 levels or fraction by which the total misses the target level. Each such botch or 10-level shortfall also gives 1 Warping Point; two or more points require a Vituperation check. The caster may use Hierarchy Score × 10 instead of the casting total only to calculate these failure consequences.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 10: The Maleficia (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to escalating failure penalties softened by Hierarchy; a world can turn the severity dial, since Hell’s retaliation tracks both the shortfall and infernal rank.

rules.statement: If the caster actually botches, they have one season to arrange the death of a person in mortal sin who does not repent; otherwise the caster dies when the season expires. Using maleficia for virtuous acts also brings evil consequences, as though the caster had the Vengeful Powers Flaw.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 10: The Maleficia (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.mechanism: law: failure and virtue incur infernal costs
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a season-long soul-debt after a botch and backlash for virtuous use; a world can alter the deadline or penalty, because Hell demands a soul and punishes misuse.

rules.statement: Crossroads Range affects a target on a different road that intersects the caster’s road, is equivalent to Voice Range, and cannot affect someone on the caster’s own road. Cursed Duration makes an effect wait for a clearly specified uncommon trigger, is equivalent to Sun but requires a second Duration for the triggered effect, and must penetrate resistance at casting; Forsaken Duration lasts while the target remains Infernal-tainted and ends immediately on repentance, but cannot be dispelled. Passion Target affects people in an area who favor a specified virtue or vice: each rolls a simple die modified by Personality Traits, and totals of 6 or more are affected.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Ranges, Durations, and Targets (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to these four Infernal-specific targeting and duration options; a world can change their thresholds or termination conditions, because crossroads, sin, and repentance shape Infernal effects.

rules.statement: Debauchery draws on the caster’s passion and uses Stamina, but requires either a long-term Fatigue level after about two minutes of preparation or a wound for faster casting. Repeating an activation ritual costs the same again and permits further Confidence spending, while adding one botch die each time; the die is rolled only when the ritual ends. A season-long ritual adds Infernal Lore and has no die roll.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Methods — Debauchery (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to bodily cost and preparation for passion-fueled casting; a world can make rituals faster or more costly, because the caster spends energy, suffers injury, or devotes a season to sin.

rules.statement: Incantation uses Communication and costs 1 Confidence Point, or the caster may take 1 Warping Point instead by committing a fitting sin. Appropriate Infernal vis adds +2 per pawn, up to Incantation + Power pawns; magical or Faerie vis at least doubles botch dice, and Divine vis is unusable unless profaned.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Methods — Incantation (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to a Confidence-or-Warping cost and capped vis bonuses; a world can change the exchange rate or eligible vis, because the rite channels Hell and other realms resist or disrupt it.

rules.statement: A failed roll gains one extra botch die for each time a Debauchery ritual is extended. A group ceremony adds every participant’s associated Method score to the total; sacrifice, vis, Confidence, and Hierarchy can also improve an effect, and these boosts may be combined.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Debauchery; Powerful Maleficia (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to pooled Method scores and combinable boosts with added botch risk for extended ritual; a world can restrict stacking, because group effort and profane resources amplify the working.

rules.statement: Infernal Powers cannot create real things: Consumption twists or transfers life and health, while Effusion manipulates existing elements and materials but cannot create them. Effusion cannot target living things, although its materials and forces may harm them; unnatural effects usually require two extra magnitudes.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Unholy Powers — Consumption; Unholy Powers — Effusion (ars-magica-realms#060)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.mechanism: law: infernal effects corrupt or redirect
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to corruption, transfer, and manipulation rather than creation; a world can broaden what counts as existing material, because Infernal power distorts what is already there.

rules.statement: An intricate phantasm, including one with recognizable details or complex senses, costs one extra magnitude; directing it to move or act mentally costs two extra magnitudes. Turning an animate target into an inanimate one also costs two extra magnitudes, and it gradually regains mobility unless the caster concentrates on the effect.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Phantasm Guidelines (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to these magnitude surcharges and gradual recovery; a world can change the surcharges or recovery rate, with greater complexity and persistence demanding more power or attention.

rules.statement: A summoning or scouring total must reach twice a spirit’s Might to summon it securely in a circle; then it remains visible and contained until dismissed or the next midday or midnight. Reaching its Might but not twice that value summons it only while the caster concentrates, and it may depart or lurk unseen if concentration breaks.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Summoning (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the double-Might threshold and concentration-dependent lesser result; a world can raise or lower the threshold, trading reliability against the caster’s effort.

rules.statement: Contacting a spirit takes minutes nearby, hours if it is more than a day’s travel away, and days or weeks across a country; the caster must concentrate throughout and always loses one Fatigue level. A secured summon ends when dismissed or at the next midday or midnight, whichever comes first.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Summoning (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to distance-based delay, sustained concentration, and one Fatigue level; a world can reduce the delay or cost, but should charge for easier or longer-range contact.

rules.statement: A spirit inside a summoning circle cannot use its Powers on the caster or anything outside the boundary, though the caster may briefly lower the ward by concentrating to let an effect pass.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Summoning (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to blocking outward effects while the boundary holds; a world can make the ward harder to breach or easier to lower, with stronger protection limiting both the spirit and caster.

rules.statement: Ablation must exceed the spirit’s Might in a circle, or twice its Might outside one; the excess permanently reduces its Might, and each five points of excess yields one Ablation Point, rounded down. The caster spends those points on listed gains, while the spirit is almost always angered and may seek revenge.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Ablating (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permanent Might loss exchanged for one point per five excess and a lasting enemy; a world can alter the exchange rate, with greater benefits worsening the harm and retaliation.

rules.statement: A bound spirit cannot leave its person or object, can use its Powers, and shares its senses with the target; a person or someone touching its object can use only the strongest bound spirit’s Might as Magic Resistance. Destroying the host releases the spirit, and a spirit bound to a person also imposes its personality traits and causes one Warping Point each year.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Binding (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to persistent binding, strongest-spirit-only resistance, and yearly Warping; a world can loosen or strengthen the bond, with greater protection risking personality influence and supernatural distortion.

rules.statement: A commanded spirit follows its task only until it is completed or the next midday or midnight; unfinished instructions must be renewed then. A follow-me instruction persists without daily renewal, but the spirit is freed if it reaches a place it cannot follow.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Commanding (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to commands expiring twice daily except follow-me; a world can extend command duration, but longer service should require renewed control or a more binding bargain.

rules.statement: A diabolist becomes aligned with Infernal power by declaring belief in Satan, renouncing God, and sealing the relationship with an oath; subsequent Infernal blessings are exchanged for service. During character creation, the role allows twice as many Virtue points as Flaw points, with ten Flaw points balancing up to twenty further Virtue points.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Mythic Companion: The Diabolist (ars-magica-realms#061)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to an oath-backed Infernal relationship that grants blessings in return for service; a world can alter the benefit or obligations, with power purchased through damnation and continuing service.

rules.statement: A demon can be restored by a Creo Vim effect that penetrates its Magic Resistance; the general guideline restores Might Pool points equal to spell level + 10, capped by its Might Score. A spell can also create a temporary Arcane Connection to a demon within range at level 4.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Guidelines (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing Might restoration and temporary connections at the stated levels; a world can restrict these practices because aiding demons attracts suspicion and risks the caster’s standing.

rules.statement: General Perdo Vim effects can lower a target’s Casting Total for a specified kind of magic by spell level + 2 magnitudes, or reduce a creature’s Might Pool by spell level + 10, provided the effect penetrates Magic Resistance. Multiple Casting Total penalties do not stack; only the strongest applies.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Guidelines (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to the listed reductions and non-stacking penalty; a world can make such magic harder to use, since its anti-demonic application is politically sensitive.

rules.statement: A general Muto Vim effect can bind a demon whose Might is no greater than spell level + 10 to a person or object. The binding lasts while the effect lasts, and can end if its containing object is broken.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Guidelines; The Wicked Jar (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to binding demons within the stated Might limit for the effect’s duration; a world can make the binding breakable or costly, reflecting the risk of releasing a hostile spirit.

rules.statement: General Rego Vim can command a demon at level 5 or summon one at level 15; the described summoning spell requires the demon’s True Name and can draw a demon of no greater Might than the spell level to the caster almost instantly. A prepared arcane circle can make it appear within that circle.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Guidelines; Adjuration of the Hell-Sworn Spirit (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to summoning by True Name within the spell’s Might ceiling; a world can require a prepared circle or impose greater danger, because the summoned demon is compelled rather than willing.

rules.statement: Apotropaic Mastery adds Mastery Score multiplied by Hierarchy Score to the effect level produced, but only for spells that directly affect Infernal Might. Goetic Mastery instead adds a relevant Goetic Art to the Casting Total and, against demons, adds Hierarchy Score × 5 to Penetration while subtracting the demon’s Hierarchy Score × 5.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Apotropaic Mastery; Goetic Mastery (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to these mastery bonuses only for eligible spirit-targeting spells; a world can make the techniques secret or stigmatized, since both can benefit infernalists as well as hunters.

rules.statement: A chthonic magus gains neither Warping Points nor aura benefits penalties from Magical and Infernal auras, and may use Infernal vis without its usual negative consequences. Their spells appear unholy to Divine or Infernal detection, and deliberate sinful action immediately before or during casting lets the magus add their lowest Art twice to a Lab or Casting Total.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — Chthonic Magic (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to aura and vis benefits alongside detection and sin requirements; a world can make the visible taint more consequential, because the power is associated with deliberate wickedness.

rules.statement: A False Gift causes Vituperation rather than Twilight when the character is exposed to Warping. If the character confesses and accepts spiritual absolution, the Gift and all Supernatural Abilities learned with it are lost; a non-magus may start with one free Supernatural Ability, which is also a False Power.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 12: Black Magic — False Magic (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to Vituperation and permanent loss of Gift-based abilities on absolution; a world can make repentance easier or harder, since cleansing the soul costs the character their powers.

rules.statement: Infernal Supernatural Abilities can be learned by characters touched by evil, using the stated seasonal study procedure and requiring a score of 1 to learn. A tradition’s four Favored Abilities avoid study penalties and are not subtracted when learning other Infernal abilities, but this benefit can come from only one tradition in a lifetime.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Chapter 13: Infernal Traditions (ars-magica-realms#062)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing study after an Infernal touch and favored study benefits from one tradition only; a world can restrict access, since Infernal tutelage or contact is the price of entry.

rules.statement: A character born with the amniotic sac still attached to the head can develop powers that let them meet and fight opponents in a shared night battle. If a combatant is killed there, they suffer paralysis equivalent to a Medium Wound.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Benandanti (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing caul-born characters to enter these dream battles; a world can restrict or broaden eligibility, with birth by caul explaining access and battle injuries carrying over as paralysis.

rules.statement: If the Benandanti win a night battle, local crops are protected and the nearby vis source yields its yearly harvest. If the stregoni win, the vis is corrupted into vis prava and may be stolen by the witches.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Story Hook: The Night Battles (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to making the battle determine the harvest and vis outcome; a world can change the stakes, with local prosperity and access to vis explaining why the conflict matters.

rules.statement: Studying the malleus epistula for one season lets a character learn one of the tradition’s four favored powers, together with advice on how to use it.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The malleus epistula (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to granting one favored power after a season of study; a world can alter the learning time or available powers, with the document serving as instruction.

rules.statement: The letter directs its reader to make six copies and send them anonymously to fellow Church members. Some versions curse readers who fail to do this, lose or misplace the letter, show it to someone, or speak about it; the threatened result varies by copy and can include the reader’s death or widespread religious and worldly catastrophe.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The malleus epistula (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to attaching a curse to breaking the letter’s secrecy and copying demands; a world can vary the penalty, with fear of punishment enforcing circulation and concealment.

rules.statement: Some stregoni transform into owls at night and fly to meetings with their coven.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Benandanti (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing a strega to take owl form at night; a world can change the form or timing, with the shape enabling secret travel.

rules.statement: A strigae leader can summon coven members to a meeting place by calling to them in dreams; the gathering’s ceremony focuses their Infernal power.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Infernal Tradition: Strigae (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to dream-calling members to a ritual gathering; a world can change who receives the call or how reliably they arrive, with shared practice focusing their power.

rules.statement: The Dread Host binds spirits to living bodies, where they can sustain a body beyond its natural limits; the spirits may also be bound to servants to keep them from fleeing and to strengthen or monitor them.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: The Dread Host (ars-magica-realms#063)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to letting bound spirits sustain or constrain a host; a world can set the degree of control and bodily cost, with the spirit’s service exchanged for continued life or aid.

rules.statement: In the witches’ moon rite, the summoner calls Selene, a succubus, and directs her to seduce the desired man. The rite uses the demon’s powers to pursue that purpose.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Drawing Down the Moon (ars-magica-realms#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to allowing a summoner to call and direct this demon; a world could restrict the rite to witches or chosen targets, because the demon’s service serves the summoner’s desire.

rules.statement: After the seduction, the witch can order Selene to take the man’s shape and have sex with her; the demon may thereby cause a pregnancy. Alternatively, Selene can depart for the sky and leave behind a foamy substance.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Drawing Down the Moon (ars-magica-realms#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to permitting the summoned demon to change shape on command; a world could limit its forms or the consequences of the rite, because these depend on the demon’s powers.

rules.statement: The substance Selene leaves, called virus lunare, can be collected from the ground and plants beneath her. It acts as an Arcane Connection to the seduced man for one month.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Drawing Down the Moon (ars-magica-realms#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to making the collected substance a temporary connection to the man; a world could change its duration or collection requirements, because the effect lasts only one month.

rules.statement: Adding virus lunare to a figurine while making it gives the figurine a fixed Arcane Connection to its target. That connection lasts while the figurine remains intact and recognizable as the target.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Drawing Down the Moon (ars-magica-realms#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to tying the connection to the figurine’s intact, recognizable state; a world could make it more or less durable, with destruction or loss of recognizability ending it.

rules.statement: Damhadh-Duidsan inscribe their incantations in Ogam; no special Ability is needed, but the user needs a Language score of at least 2 to sound out the letters.
locators: Ars Magica 5e Realms of Power: Ogam Writing (ars-magica-realms#064)
rules.speaker: rulebook
rules.default_dial_reason: Default to requiring Language 2 for reading the inscribed incantations; a world could raise or remove that threshold, trading accessibility against the tradition’s specialized practice.
